title: About the conference
description:
MemDesAI 2027 is an international academic conference dedicated to advancing innovative membrane technologies, sustainable desalination processes, artificial intelligence-driven solutions, and emerging approaches to environmental protection and circular resource recovery. The conference aims to bring together leading researchers, academicians, industry professionals, policymakers, and technology developers from across the globe to exchange knowledge, share cutting-edge research, foster interdisciplinary collaborations, and explore transformative solutions to global water, energy, and environmental challenges.

The conference will provide an international platform for discussing recent advances in membrane science and engineering, next-generation desalination technologies, AI and machine learning applications, computational modelling, water and wastewater treatment, resource recovery, and sustainable environmental management. Particular emphasis will be placed on translating scientific innovations into practical technologies, strengthening academia–industry partnerships, and promoting sustainable and resilient water management solutions.

Through keynote lectures, plenary sessions, technical presentations, panel discussions, and networking opportunities, MemDesAI 2027 aspires to establish itself as a leading international forum at the intersection of membrane science, artificial intelligence, desalination, and environmental sustainability.

institutions.name: IIT Roorkee
institutions.description: Host and joint organizer of MemDesAI-2027. The Department of Hydrology and Centre for Nanotechnology contribute expertise in desalination, membrane distillation, nanocomposite membrane fabrication and computational modelling. IIT Roorkee will lead the Desalination and Environmental Sustainability tracks.

institutions.name: CSIR-IIP
institutions.description: Joint organizer of MemDesAI-2027. CSIR–Indian Institute of Petroleum, Dehradun, contributes expertise in catalysis, petroleum refining, industrial membrane applications, process modelling and plant-level data analytics. It will co-lead the Membrane Technology track and support engagement with the petroleum and energy sectors.

institutions.name: HKUST
institutions.description: The Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology collaborates on MemDesAI-2027. Prof. Alicia Kyoung Jin An is listed in the proposal’s International Advisory Committee.
